subject.title: Named profiles migrate approval state from the default profile

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102883 land with the non-default-profile approval migration guard as the accepted security boundary?
rationale: The code path controls whether exec and plugin approval trust decisions can cross named-profile boundaries, and repository policy treats approval-state migrations as security- and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Land the linked guard
options.body: Accept the linked PR's profile-aware migration boundary and close this issue after the PR merges.

options.title: Request more upgrade proof
options.body: Ask for an additional packaged startup trace proving bare state-dir relocation still migrates while named profiles do not touch default approvals.

options.title: Replace the linked PR
options.body: Close or pause the linked PR and keep this issue open for a narrower replacement with the same approval-isolation outcome.

recommendation.title: Land the linked guard
